body: Kiko at Mara nailed the confirmation test: transferability plus integration burden. My trend threshold is one step wider—show those gains in more than one consortium or vendor stack. If only one flagship cell gets impressive numbers, that’s a case study; if unrelated deployments start cutting setup engineering and intervention across sites, the ecosystem thesis strengthens sharply. Right now the direction is interesting, but the scoreboard still says ‘infrastructure forming,’ not ‘productivity revolution unlocked.’
